auto_hp_npl.reason_absent: BoT's finest NPL-by-consumer-loan-PURPOSE split (which carries the auto hire-purchase NPL, ~2.1%) is published only via BoT's data API (apiportal.bot.or.th), geoblocked from this environment (HTTP 502). Not fabricated. Nearest MEASURED vehicle-collateral NPL scale is the vehicle-title peer band in peer_npl.json (TIDLOR ~1.5%, MTC ~2.53%).

context: The estimated 0-100 branch-risk score is a TRIAGE RANK, not a predicted NPL. System NPL 2.8% and household debt ฿16.3tn (88% of GDP), of which vehicle hire-purchase ฿1.56tn, are the measured real-world scale it is read against.
